additional_info.body:
BUS: 1 GSH: 0 GSS: 2 SDC: 1 SLK: 1 ErrorCode: 4
BUS: 1 GSH: 1 GSS: 1 SDC: 2 SLK: 1 ErrorCode: 6
BUS: 1 GSH: 1 GSS: 1 SDC: 1 SLK: 1 ErrorCode: 1
BUS: 1 GSH: 0 GSS: 1 SDC: 1 SLK: 1 ErrorCode: 16
BUS: 0 GSH: 1 GSS: 1 SDC: 1 SLK: 1 ErrorCode: 3
BUS=1 -> CAN bus comm. with HPC cable ok
GSH=0 -> Hardwired good signal lost / wiring error / LOGO comm. lost / 24V to cable lost
GSS: 1= Cable reports good signal from software over CAN bus
GSS=2 -> Software good signal from HPC can bus not ok (summary signal = not ok)
SDC=1 -> HPC CAN bus reports DC contacts and DC cable state ok
SLK: 1= Cable reports no internal liquid leakage via its sensor over CAN bus
SLK=2 -> HPC can bus reports something is wrong with internal leakage signal
Error code = 4 -> Cable GoodSignal CAN Bus Lost while CAN communication is OK
Error code = 1 ->
Cable Good Signal HW IO Digital Input Lost while charging OFF
Error code = 3 →
Cable CAN communication Lost while charging is OFF
Error code = 16 →
Cable DC contact Sensor Temperature Measurement Range Invalid
Error code = 6 →
Cable or DC contact Sensor Failure

additional_info.subject: Note
additional_info.body:
DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101
VIV:0 COV1 KON:1 CBL:1
VIV:0 CCE:0 RNE:0 PLE:0 SOV:0 COV:1 CBL:0 KON:1 CAB:1 HOU:0
The following values show the
error state
(OK state would be the negated value):
VIV:0 → in case of an invalid sensor reading
CCE:1→ in case of missing cable configuration
RNE:1 → in case of an sensor reading outside the defined operation range
PLE:1→ in case of an plausibility error (temperature difference between +/- 25 deg C too high)
SOV:1 → in case of the defined overheat limit is exceeded
COV:1→ in case of the CAN bus read out temperature values has exceeded the defined overheat limit
CBL:1 → in case of CAN Bus communication lost
KON:1: → in case the contact temperature sensors are not okay
CBL:1 → in case the cable temperature sensors are not okay
HOU:1 → in case the housing temperature sensor is not okay
CFeed:1 → in case the coolant feed temperature sensor is not okay
CRet:1 → in case the coolant return temperature sensors are not okay

:
For
'DC2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan/Pump' error
The issue should be inside the cable, there's still a chance that we are talking about a false contact on the CAN bus line
Need to check below points in charger:
In details, here are the contacts and connectors to verify:
F01-XD34 pins 13-15-25-26-27-28
F01-XD37 pins 1-2-3-5-6-7-10-11-12-13-14-15-16-18
Please provide m a feedback …
For
'DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101'
Following points needs to be checked
1) Check CC2 Plug if there is any water Ingress or Moisture
2)  Check tightness of cable in Terminal F03-XD16
3) As checked the PT1000 value for DC 2 from AWS , Values is not OK
Suspect the PT1000 are not Ok & cable need to be changed.
For future reference, your case number is
0415505
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
